**metrics:** the live `🟩` block keeps its estimate rows only on a terminal; an agent's shell tool, a pipe or a file gets the identity header alone (`PIXEL_METRICS=full` restores the rows), so a model no longer reads them after every call: 396 → 67 bytes of stderr for a one-line `search-content`. The metrics relay answers with the user-visible `systemMessage` only, and the skill no longer asks the model to repeat the line.
